# Joko Widodo, 2024, 1B.3 Research Note

Scope note: For Indonesia, this lens is mostly about civilian nuclear and radioactive-material safeguards, transport custody, inspections, and safety culture. I did not find evidence of presidential warhead command-and-control, since Indonesia is not a nuclear-armed state.

## Accepted claims

| Valence | Title | Publisher / date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Favorable | [Peraturan Bapeten No. 5 Tahun 2024](https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/312070/peraturan-bapeten-no-5-tahun-2024) | BAPETEN / 2024-12-31 | https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/312070/peraturan-bapeten-no-5-tahun-2024 | Indonesia adopted a new radioactive-substances security regulation covering risk categories, security programs, transport security actions, and verification records. That is direct evidence of tighter custody and accident-prevention safeguards in 2024. | `1B.3`, `1B.1` |
| Favorable | [BAPETEN Gandeng US DOE, Perkuat Sistem Keamanan Sumber Radioaktif](https://www.bapeten.go.id/berita/bapeten-gandeng-us-doe-perkuat-sistem-keamanan-sumber-radioaktif-155120?lang=id) | BAPETEN / 2024-04-22 | https://www.bapeten.go.id/berita/bapeten-gandeng-us-doe-perkuat-sistem-keamanan-sumber-radioaktif-155120?lang=id | BAPETEN trained inspectors with US DOE support to improve inspection competence and detection of noncompliance in radioactive-source security. This supports stronger operational discipline and safety oversight. | `1B.3` |
| Favorable | [Kegiatan Inspeksi Physical Inventory Verification (PIV) IAEA di Indonesia Tahun 2024](https://bapeten.go.id/berita/kegiatan-inspeksi-physical-inventory-verification-piv-iaea-di-indonesia-tahun-2024-143819) | BAPETEN / 2024-07-04 | https://bapeten.go.id/berita/kegiatan-inspeksi-physical-inventory-verification-piv-iaea-di-indonesia-tahun-2024-143819 | IAEA conducted routine safeguards inspections at multiple Indonesian nuclear installations, with BAPETEN accompaniment, to verify no undeclared nuclear material or activities. That is direct safeguards discipline evidence. | `1B.3`, `1B.1` |
| Favorable | [Rapat Koordinasi Persiapan Deklarasi Protokol Tambahan 2024](https://www.bapeten.go.id/berita/rapat-koordinasi-persiapan-deklarasi-protokol-tambahan-2024-092158?lang=en) | BAPETEN / 2024-05-03 | https://www.bapeten.go.id/berita/rapat-koordinasi-persiapan-deklarasi-protokol-tambahan-2024-092158?lang=en | BAPETEN coordinated Indonesia’s annual Additional Protocol declaration to the IAEA and warned that inaccurate or opaque reporting would hinder nuclear technology trade. This supports administrative control and safeguards discipline. | `1B.3`, `1B.1` |
| Negative / cautionary | [Missing dangerous source during transport had been found](https://www-news.iaea.org/ErfView.aspx?mId=fd650b1f-e5df-4c29-8674-64f16b1d610c) | IAEA / 2024-05-28 | https://www-news.iaea.org/ErfView.aspx?mId=fd650b1f-e5df-4c29-8674-64f16b1d610c | A gamma camera containing Ir-192 was reported missing during transport in Surabaya in January 2024 and later recovered intact. Even though no radiation release occurred, the incident shows a real custody lapse and weak point in transport security. | `1B.3` |
| Favorable | [Nuclear Safety Seminar and Nuclear Product Exhibition 2024](https://bapeten.go.id/berita/nuclear-safety-seminar-and-nuclear-product-exhibition-2024-101615?lang=id) | BAPETEN / 2024-08-21 | https://bapeten.go.id/berita/nuclear-safety-seminar-and-nuclear-product-exhibition-2024-101615?lang=id | BAPETEN and ITPLN held a 2024 seminar on improving nuclear safety and security, including expert participation and public-sector technical exchange. This indicates active safety-culture reinforcement during Jokowi’s final year. | `1B.3` |

## Synthesis

The 2024 record supports a **positive but institutional** judgment on `1B.3`:

- Strong evidence: Indonesia tightened radioactive-source security rules, trained inspectors, and maintained IAEA safeguards inspections.
- Negative evidence: at least one transport-security incident occurred, so safeguards were not flawless.
- What I did **not** find: a source showing Jokowi personally issued a distinct command-and-control or custody overhaul, or evidence of a large presidential failure in this area.

## Search gap

Reliable evidence is **indirect rather than personal**. The best 2024 material is about BAPETEN, the foreign ministry, and IAEA cooperation under Jokowi’s government, not a direct presidential command-and-control initiative. If you need a stricter ruler-level reading, the next step would be to score this as institutional-strengthening with a small penalty for the transport incident and for the lack of direct presidential attribution.
